name: Seed Pod
desc: A dehiscent seed capsule the height of the stage, staged against a toned specimen ground and running its whole life in a loop — the pod swells, the sutures crack, the valves splay back off the placenta and the seeds ride out on their pappus while the wind walks the whole silhouette across the frame, then the husk dries, reflexes, and a new pod begins to swell.

energy.doc: stalk sway/bob amplitude, seed shed rate and glow — the whole silhouette walks, it does not wiggle

scale.doc: hero size — at 1 the CAPSULE alone stands ~0.47 of the short edge; at 2 it overfills the frame as a macro study

hue.doc: husk hue (the ground is keyed off it)

speed.doc: rate multiplier on the life cycle and sway

density.doc: seed count and engraved hatching density

x.doc: stalk base x (the ground pool follows it)

plump.doc: capsule proportion: slim pod to fat lantern

neck.doc: stalk length as a fraction of the capsule

ground.doc: the toned specimen ground the pod is staged against — 0 removes it entirely to composite the pod over a live scene

pose.doc: idle sway / wind-bent lean / beat-flexed bursting

style.doc: botanical: mid-key engraved husk on toned specimen ground · xray: radiograph, form from transmitted density only · silhouette: pure abstract mass, no interior · bronze: cast metal with specular and verdigris
